svg.title: A DOI — a persistent identifier
svg.desc: 18-unit grid, 1-unit stroke, keyline landscape 13x9. Two interlocking links: a DOI is a persistent identifier that RESOLVES to a work, not the work itself — the same work carries concept, version and preprint DOIs, and a DOI may point at software or a dataset. Replaces an earlier document shape, which named the wrong thing and duplicated a rectangular silhouette the set already had. Re-measure with npm run icons.
